name: One&Only Moonlight Basin, Montana
insider_take: This ultra-luxe mountain retreat sits at 7,500 feet elevation in the heart of Big Sky's wilderness, offering unparalleled access to some of North America's most pristine powder skiing and breathtaking Montana vistas.
whats_special: One&Only Moonlight Basin is the first North American property for the ultra-luxury One&Only brand, featuring ski-in/ski-out access to Big Sky Resort - home to the famous Lone Peak with its 4,350-foot vertical drop. The resort sits on a working ranch with over 40,000 acres of untouched wilderness, and Big Sky boasts the least crowded slopes in America with an average of just 5 skiers per acre.
pro_tip: Book during late January through February for the deepest powder snow, and don't miss the ranch's exclusive heli-skiing experiences that access untouched terrain only available to resort guests.
dont_miss: The resort's signature "Mountain to Table" dining featuring locally-sourced bison and elk, plus stargazing sessions in one of America's darkest skies - Big Sky has minimal light pollution making it perfect for viewing the Milky Way. In summer, witness the nearby Yellowstone ecosystem with possible sightings of grizzly bears, wolves, and massive elk herds.
pros: Spectacular mountain views and pristine wilderness setting in Big Sky
World-class ski access to Big Sky Resort slopes
Luxury mountain lodge with premium amenities and spa services
Four-season outdoor activities including skiing, hiking, and wildlife viewing
cons: Remote mountain location requiring travel planning
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive mountain resort experience
